transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what's been troubling you and what brings you in today?

I guess… people at work thought I was acting weird. At the warehouse I’d kind of freeze near the forklift with my arms up, or copy the beeping and the hand signals. Sometimes I was moving boxes into… little patterns, I guess. They kept telling me to stop.
Have there been times when you felt unable to move or respond, or when others may have noticed that you were not moving or reacting to things around you?

Yeah… I think so. At work I’d kind of stop by the forklift with my arms up and not really answer right away. People would yell at me to stop messing around, but I’d just… stay like that, or start copying the beeps and the hand signals. Sometimes I’d move boxes into little patterns instead of doing what I was supposed to.
Has this kind of behavior or experience come on suddenly, or have you felt like this for a longer time?
It wasn’t sudden. It’s been going on a while… maybe around six months, the talking getting mixed up and the stuff at the warehouse.
Have you had times when you felt completely frozen or unable to move, not because you were tired or distracted, but like your body just wouldn’t respond?

Yeah… sometimes. Like at the warehouse, I’d just be standing there by the forklift with my arms up and not really… move. People would yell, and I knew they were yelling, but I’d just stay like that for a bit. Then I might start copying the beeps or the hand signals.
Have you ever felt like you were completely disconnected from what was going on around you, like you were in your own world, while you were acting this way at work?

Yeah… kind of. I don’t know if I’d call it disconnected, but at the warehouse I’d just be there by the forklift with my arms up, not really doing what I was supposed to. I’d copy the beeps or the hand signals, or move boxes into these little patterns, even when people were yelling at me to stop.
Have you ever seen, heard, or felt things that others around you didn’t seem to notice, like voices or visions?
I don’t know… not really. I mean, I haven’t noticed anything like that.
Have there been times when you believed something strongly that others didn’t seem to understand or agree with, even when there was no clear reason for it?
I don’t think so… not like that. I mean, people don’t always get what I’m doing, but I wouldn’t say I had some strong belief or anything.
Have there been times when you remained completely still for a long period, not responding to others at all, or when your body seemed to resist being moved by someone else?

Yeah… I mean, I’ve frozen up by the forklift with my arms up for a while. People yell at me to stop, but I just kind of stay there. Or I’ll start copying the beeps and hand signals instead of working. I don’t know about someone trying to move me, though.
Have there been times when you didn't speak at all for several hours, or when you didn't respond to people trying to talk to you or get your attention?

I don’t know about not talking for hours. Mostly… I just kind of stop doing what I’m supposed to do. Like at the warehouse I’ll freeze with my arms up near the forklift, or copy the beeps and hand signals, or move boxes around in weird patterns even when people are yelling at me.
Have you experienced similar freezing or inability to move in places other than the warehouse, like at home or when you're with friends or family?

Not really… I mean, the stuff they’re talking about is mostly at the warehouse. Like freezing by the forklift with my arms up, or copying the beeps and signals, moving boxes around in those little patterns. I don’t really know about home.
Have you ever experienced the same kind of freezing or strange behavior in places other than the warehouse, like at home or when you're with friends or family?

I don’t really know. It’s mostly the warehouse stuff… freezing by the forklift, copying the beeps and signals, moving boxes around weird even when people are yelling. I can’t really say it happens other places.
Have there been times when your mood was very low for several days, or when you felt extremely energized or irritable for no clear reason?
I don’t really know. I mean… I get stressed or tired sometimes, but I haven’t noticed anything like that for days. Not really.
Have you ever found yourself unable to move or acting in a strange, repetitive way in situations other than at work, even when you were not around the forklift or hearing its beeps?

I don’t really know about other situations. What people keep saying is… at work, by the forklift, I freeze with my arms up, or I copy the beeps and the hand signals. Sometimes I move boxes around in these little patterns even when they’re yelling at me to stop. That’s mostly what I know.
Have you ever found yourself unable to move or acting in a strange, repetitive way in situations other than at work, even when you were not around the forklift or hearing its beeps?

I… I’m not sure about other places. It’s really the warehouse they keep talking about. By the forklift I’ll freeze with my arms up, or copy the beeps and hand signals. Sometimes I move boxes in these little patterns even when people are yelling at me to stop. Outside of that… I don’t really know.
Have you ever found yourself unable to move or acting in a strange, repetitive way in situations other than at work, even when you were not around the forklift or hearing its beeps?

Like I said… I only really know about the warehouse. By the forklift I freeze up with my arms raised, or I end up copying the beeps and hand signals. Sometimes I move boxes around in weird little patterns even when people are yelling at me to stop. Outside of that, I don’t really know.
Have you had any difficulties interacting with others or completing tasks in situations outside of work, such as at home or in social settings?

Yeah… I guess so. I got taken off the forklift stuff, and I’m behind in my community college classes. I also stopped going to the church food-bank shifts. People said they couldn’t really count on me… or keep things safe with me there.
Have you ever experienced the same kind of freezing or strange, repetitive behavior outside of work, such as at home or in social situations?

I… I don’t really know about home or social stuff. The main thing is at the warehouse. That’s where I freeze with my arms up by the forklift, or copy the beeps and hand signals… move boxes in those patterns even when people are yelling at me to stop.
Have you ever experienced the same kind of freezing or strange, repetitive behavior outside of work, such as at home or when you're with friends or family?

I don’t really know about with friends or family. It’s mostly that warehouse stuff… freezing with my arms up by the forklift, making the beep sounds or copying the hand signals. And the boxes… I move them into those little patterns even when people are telling me to stop.
